newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI prepares for sell-off of Autostrade.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI prepares for sell-off of Autostrade.

text.p: Italian state holding IRI said on Tuesday it would take direct control of motorway operator Autostrade, removing it from the books of its 100 percent-owned unit, Fintecna.
Autostrade is slated for privatisation by June 1997.
The decision to de-merge the company from Fintecna, which held some 66.2 percent of the firm, means that IRI will receive all the proceeds from its eventual sell-off.
IRI previously held just 20.75 percent of the company with the remaining 13 percent listed on the Milan bourse in the shape of preference shares.
IRI has been given until next June to drastically reduce its debt mountain as part of a deal with the European Commission.
The giant state holding said in a statement that Fintecna would continue to manage its remaining holdings which are mostly concentrated in the construction and airport service sector.
However these too will eventually be privatised, it added.
